## Author — before requesting review

- [ ] A **new publication branch** and **one Draft PR** (base `main`) were created.
- [ ] A completed publication summary is attached and contact information is sufficient.
- [ ] The PR has an accessible **manuscript PDF with version/date** and text for line comments.
- [ ] All authors/contributors, abstract, section outline, target venue and data rights are declared.
- [ ] This public sandbox contains **no real sensitive data**, unpublished confidential manuscript or rights-restricted material.
- [ ] PubCom has been informed of the Draft PR; author has **not** self-appointed reviewers.

## Paper Handler — intake and opening

- [ ] Title, version, access, author contacts, category/class/stream and data rights checked.
- [ ] Current ISSC policy and proper deadlines checked (mock meeting uses a **compressed simulation** only).
- [ ] One category, one class, one timeline and **current** status labels applied.
- [ ] Draft changed to **Ready for review**; reviewer invitations sent; PR/deadline announced.

## Review / revision

- [ ] Reviewer 1 and Reviewer 2 submitted feedback on the scientific manuscript.
- [ ] Each `Request:` was answered **in its own thread** and linked to a revision or reasoned response.
- [ ] Author added a **versioned revision** and updated summary revision log.
- [ ] Each blocking scientific point has a recorded resolution, adjudication, or outstanding condition.

## Handler recommendation → Chair decision

- [ ] Handler wrote a **separate recommendation** and summarized remaining concerns.
- [ ] Chair wrote a **separate dated decision** (approve / conditional / return for revision / other).
- [ ] Rights/attribution and final manuscript version were checked where applicable.
- [ ] PR was labelled/closed/merged only as appropriate, with explicit `TRAINING ONLY — NO PUBLICATION CLEARANCE` for a mock paper.

> `Request:` is a substantive scientific/procedural comment prefix. GitHub's `Request changes` and `Approve` states are platform controls **not ISSC decisions**. Unresolved conversations block merging only if enforced by repository protection settings.
